note: Public data = audience signals, not leads. Each segment below says where those people can be legitimately reached and what would make them voluntarily start the Health Coverage Check. Reach/where/search items are HYPOTHESES (UNTESTED) until the Distribution Lab shows real visits and phone submissions from them. Search terms are not volume-checked (no keyword tool connected).

segments.circumstance: Cigna, Molina and Sunshine State Health Plan leave Florida's individual market for 2027; proposed increases average ~15.9% (Florida Blue PPO ~26%). Letters arrive in October; the Dec 15 deadline decides Jan 1 coverage.
questions: My insurance company is leaving, what do I do?
¿Molina se va de Florida?
Why did my renewal go up so much?
¿Qué pasa si no escojo otro plan?

organizations: Spanish news outlets already covering 2027 changes (DirectorioCubano, Periódico Cubano, Telemundo 51)

segments.circumstance: Just licensed; brokerages treat agents as 1099 contractors, so no employer health plan. Often left a W-2 job (60-day SEP) or are buying their own plan for the first time.
questions: Do real estate agents get health insurance from the brokerage?
Can I deduct health insurance as a 1099 agent?
How do I estimate income for the Marketplace when commissions are uneven?

organizations: Pre-licensing schools (Gold Coast, Florida Realtors School, Aprendiendo Real Estate USA)
search: seguro médico para agentes de bienes raíces
content: 'Your brokerage doesn't give you health insurance' short video

segments.circumstance: Booth renters and suite operators are self-employed and have to arrange their own coverage.
questions: Can booth renters get health insurance?
How much is health insurance if I'm self-employed in Florida?

organizations: Salon-suite operators (Sola, MY SALON Suite, local suites)
content: Day-in-the-life booth renter + 'who covers you?' hook

segments.circumstance: New shop owner covering themselves; may also ask about covering staff (small-group question for the agent).
questions: Do I have to offer my staff health insurance?

segments.circumstance: Left employer benefits to start a business; needs individual coverage, often with family.
questions: What do I do about health insurance after leaving my job to start a business?

seguro médico para dueños de negocio

segments.circumstance: Got their own authority; the company's benefits stayed with the company (60-day SEP if coverage just ended).
questions: Health insurance for owner operators?
